newsitem.title: UK: Oceonics to focus on improving operations.
newsitem.headline: Oceonics to focus on improving operations.

text.p: British marine services firm Oceonics Group Plc said on Wednesday it planned to focus on improving its operations after the 6.1 million stg sale of its loss-making survey and positioning business to Fugro NV of the Netherlands.
The company also said it planned at the time of its annual results in 1997 to propose mechanisms to enable shareholders to receive value for their investment.
Oceonics said it had considered a range of options for the unit, including buying other businesses to increase market share, but had decided the disposal was the best route.
Oceonics reported a pre-tax profit of 2.7 million stg for the six months ended September 30, compared to a loss of 1.6 million stg in the year-ago period.
Current year results included a pre-tax gain of 3.3 million stg related to its flotation of Gall Thomson Environmental.
Oceonics shares slid 0.5p to 19.5 by 1130 GMT.
